product_metadata.title: COTTON CRAFT Soft Cotton Thermal Blanket - Plush Herringbone Twill - All Season Luxurious Breathable Skin Friendly Lightweight Cooling Throw Blanket - Sofa Couch Travel Camping Dorm - Twin White
features: CONTENTS: One (1) White Twin Size Herringbone Cotton Thermal Twill Blanket
DIMENSIONS: Twin size measures 60 inches by 90 inches
STYLE: Herringbone twill design woven from 100% pure cotton
ALL SEASON: Medium weight makes it ideal for all seasons. Soft, cozy and durable for long use. Ideal for layering with any bedding ensemble.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Easy care. Machine wash cold water on gentle cycle. Wash dark colors separately. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low.

details.Product Care Instructions: Machine wash cold water on gentle cycle
